stem: What happens next in this passage after “She stopped buying drinks after school and brought water from home.”?
options: There is an old radio in Mr. Wang's noodle shop.
She also helped her aunt clean the shop on weekends.
The students also asked shop owners about business.
The town learned that buying clean technology also means building support for it.

本文可直接核對「She stopped buying drinks after school and brought water from home. She also helped her aunt clean the shop on weekends.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
